column3: Close to the Greek; BSB names Paul.
Encouragement is placed before thanksgiving instead of after it.
“Our” is supplied twice; the taking prisoner is explicitly located in Jerusalem.
“The leaders” names the speakers; “from there” specifies the brothers’ origin.
“Refused” makes the unbelief explicitly a refusal.
This verse is absent from the critical text, and BSB omits it; the Textus Receptus reads “And when he had said these things, the Jews departed, having much dispute among themselves.”
BSB’s “Paul” matches the Textus Receptus (Παῦλος); the critical text has only “he.”
